result.summary: Found 1 minor cosmetic issue with the bottom navigation bar.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar's icons (home, search, bookmark, profile) are partially obscured by a thin black line at the very bottom edge of the screen, cutting off the lower part of the icons.
issues.suggestion: Remove the overlapping black line at the bottom of the screen, or adjust the bottom padding of the navigation bar to ensure all icons are fully visible and unobscured.
